# Sign of Nine

> Numerology and angel numbers explained in plain English, with the arithmetic shown and the tradition named. Pythagorean system throughout; readings are presented as readings, never as predictions.

Written and maintained by Ayush Sondhi. Method: https://signofnine.com/editorial-approach/

## Sections

- Angel numbers, with a page per number and per clock time: https://signofnine.com/angel-numbers/
- Number meanings 0 to 9, 11, 22, 33: https://signofnine.com/numbers/
- Life path numbers and calculator: https://signofnine.com/life-path/
- Compatibility by life path: https://signofnine.com/compatibility/
- Personal year calculator and meanings: https://signofnine.com/personal-year/
- Articles on how numerology works: https://signofnine.com/articles/

## Rules every page follows

- A number is reduced by adding its digits until one digit remains; 11, 22 and 33 are kept.
- Every angel-number page explains the frequency illusion before any reading.
- Health, money and legal topics are described as readings and point to a professional.
